notes.title: Happy Oshare Time v1.1.0
notes.content:
Patch Note


Added a fixed streaming camera. It shows a 3rd person view on your screen.
Added name input feature. You can now input your name by clicking a button bottom right of the play type select(title) window.
The size of the nameplate is now consistent.
Changed the font of the nameplate for visibility.
Mirrors don't reflect your name anymore.
You can't see your nameplate through a VR headset.
Added a live camera in front of you in the stage scene. This makes slide notes hard to see, so we fixed it by darkening them.
Previously, you could see lobbies whose owner isn't your friend. Now there are friend's rooms only on your lobby list.
Fixed short freeze on showing the result window for the first time in a play.


Known issues


Friend's lobby remains on the list even after the friend closed it.
Sometimes failed to join a friend's lobby. Please try again in this situation.
When a connection is unstable, blackout after a live stage becomes much longer than usual.


Note

This patch gains GPU load, especially in the stage scene. If you have trouble with this, please contact us with your PC specs.
